Resource Profile: Task - FR Task Patient Transport Document

Official URL: https://interop.esante.gouv.fr/ig/fhir/document-core/StructureDefinition/fr-task-patient-transport-document Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2026-07-08 Computable Name: FRTaskPatientTransportDocument

FRTaskPatientTransportDocument permet de décrire le transport d'un patient/usager lors d'un déplacement (entrée ou sortie d'hôpital, …).

Usages:

  • This Profile is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
